messages.text:
Your refund is **BRL 24.90**, the amount paid for the pot after its discount. (refund-policy/v2/amount)

It goes to the order’s original payment—the voucher—not another card or account. (refund-policy/v2/payment)

Please confirm using the **button on the proposal card**; a typed “yes” does not confirm it. A staff member must then approve it before payment. (refund-policy/v2/approval)

In this demo, the receipt records a test-ledger refund, not a real transfer or guaranteed voucher-credit date. (refund-policy/v2/payout)
